gh: gh pr create --title Fix login loop: refresh() now fetches a new session instead of recursing --body Fixes #7

`refresh()` in `src/auth.js` called itself when the session was expired, causing infinite recursion and freezing the page. It now delegates to a new `fetchSession()` helper that requests a fresh session from `/api/session` and returns it.
- `refresh()` returns `fetchSession()` for expired sessions, the existing session otherwise
- `fetchSession()` throws on non-OK responses so failures surface instead of hanging
